functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.apply_fsm_event(p_entity_type text, p_entity_id uuid, p_from_state text, p_to_state text, p_role text, p_action text)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
AS $function$
DECLARE
    v_valid boolean;
BEGIN
    -- Validate transition
    SELECT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM fsm_transitions t
        WHERE t.entity_type = p_entity_type
          AND t.from_state = p_from_state
          AND t.to_state = p_to_state
          AND t.action = p_action
          AND p_role = ANY(t.allowed_roles)
    )
    INTO v_valid;

    IF NOT v_valid THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'FSM VIOLATION: invalid transition % → % for role % action %', 
            p_from_state, p_to_state, p_role, p_action;
    END IF;

    -- Apply transition
    UPDATE fsm_entity_state
    SET
        previous_state = current_state,
        current_state = p_to_state,
        updated_at = now()
    WHERE entity_type = p_entity_type
      AND entity_id = p_entity_id;

    -- Log event
    INSERT INTO fsm_events (
        entity_type,
        entity_id,
        from_state,
        to_state,
        action,
        role,
        created_at
    ) VALUES (
        p_entity_type,
        p_entity_id,
        p_from_state,
        p_to_state,
        p_action,
        p_role,
        now()
    );
END;
$function$
functions.identity_arguments: p_entity_type text, p_entity_id uuid, p_from_state text, p_to_state text, p_role text, p_action text

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.approve_grading(p_script_id uuid, p_reviewer_id uuid, p_final_score numeric, p_teacher_feedback text DEFAULT NULL::text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
AS $function$
DECLARE
    v_script_id UUID;
BEGIN
    UPDATE public.answer_scripts
    SET 
        final_score = p_final_score,
        reviewed_by = p_reviewer_id,
        reviewed_at = NOW(),
        status = 'approved',
        teacher_feedback = p_teacher_feedback,
        updated_at = NOW()
    WHERE id = p_script_id
    AND status IN ('pending_review', 'processing')
    RETURNING id INTO v_script_id;

    IF v_script_id IS NULL THEN
        RETURN jsonb_build_object('success', false, 'error', 'Script not found or not in review state');
    END IF;

    RETURN jsonb_build_object(
        'success', true,
        'script_id', v_script_id,
        'status', 'approved',
        'final_score', p_final_score
    );
END;
$function$

 RETURNS jsonb

    INSERT INTO tenant_identity_map (

    )
    VALUES (

        p_institution_id,

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.create_institution_account(_institution_name text, _institution_type text, _registration_number text, _school_type text, _country text, _address text, _state text, _lga text, _phone text, _email text, _website text, _principal_name text, _principal_phone text, _principal_email text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public', 'extensions'
AS $function$
DECLARE
    v_institution_id UUID;
    v_school_id UUID;
    v_profile_id UUID;
    v_url_slug TEXT;
BEGIN
    -- 1. Generate URL slug from institution name
    v_url_slug := lower(regexp_replace(_institution_name, '[^a-zA-Z0-9]+', '-', 'g'));
    v_url_slug := regexp_replace(v_url_slug, '^-+|-+$', '', 'g');
    
    -- Ensure uniqueness by appending a random suffix if needed
    IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.schools WHERE url_slug = v_url_slug) THEN
        v_url_slug := v_url_slug || '-' || substr(gen_random_uuid()::text, 1, 4);
    END IF;

    -- 2. Create the Institution
    INSERT INTO public.institutions (
        name, 
        type, 
        country, 
        registration_number, 
        address, 
        phone, 
        website_url, 
        established_year, 
        institution_category
    ) VALUES (
        _institution_name, 
        _institution_type, 
        _country, 
        _registration_number, 
        _address, 
        _phone, 
        _website, 
        extract(year from now())::int, 
        _institution_type
    ) RETURNING id INTO v_institution_id;

    -- 3. Create the School (with complete corporate data)
    INSERT INTO public.schools (
        institution_id, 
        school_name, 
        principal_name, 
        principal_email, 
        address, 
        phone,
        campus_address,
        campus_phone,
        school_type,
        url_slug
    ) VALUES (
        v_institution_id,
        _institution_name || ' Main Campus',
        _principal_name,
        _principal_email,
        _address,
        _phone,
        _address,
        _phone,
        _school_type,
        v_url_slug
    ) RETURNING id INTO v_school_id;

    -- 4. Create the Admin Profile (using Auth UID if already logged in, or generating one)
    -- Simplified: we assume the caller is not yet authenticated (signup flow)
    -- In a real scenario, you would link to auth.uid() or a new auth.user
    -- For this phase, we create a placeholder and link via the frontend later
    v_profile_id := gen_random_uuid();

    INSERT INTO public.profiles (
        id, 
        user_id, 
        institution_id, 
        full_name, 
        role
    ) VALUES (
        v_profile_id,
        v_profile_id, -- Uses same UUID; will be linked to auth user later
        v_institution_id, 
        _principal_name, 
        'principal_admin'
    );

    -- 5. Seed Onboarding Flags
    INSERT INTO public.institution_onboarding (institution_id, school_created, classes_created, subjects_created, teachers_created, students_created, completed)
    VALUES (v_institution_id, true, false, false, false, false, false);

    -- 6. Seed 14-Day Trial Subscription
    INSERT INTO public.tenant_subscriptions (institution_id, plan, status, trial_started_at, trial_ends_at)
    VALUES (v_institution_id, 'standard', 'trialing', now(), now() + interval '14 days');

    -- 7. Return the receipt required by the UX Blueprint
    RETURN jsonb_build_object(
        'success', true,
        'institution_id', v_institution_id,
        'school_id', v_school_id,
        'profile_id', v_profile_id,
        'url_slug', v_url_slug,
        'subscription_status', 'trialing',
        'trial_ends_at', now() + interval '14 days',
        'receipt_number', 'GRD-' || to_char(now(), 'YYYYMMDD') || '-' || substr(gen_random_uuid()::text, 1, 6)
    );
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fsm_transition(p_entity_type text, p_entity_id uuid, p_from_state text, p_to_state text, p_institution_id uuid, p_metadata jsonb)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
DECLARE
  allowed BOOLEAN;
BEGIN

  SELECT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM fsm_transitions
    WHERE entity_type = p_entity_type
      AND from_state = p_from_state
      AND to_state = p_to_state
  ) INTO allowed;

  IF NOT allowed THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Invalid FSM transition';
  END IF;

  INSERT INTO fsm_entity_state (
    institution_id,
    entity_type,
    entity_id,
    current_state,
    previous_state,
    context
  )
  VALUES (
    p_institution_id,
    p_entity_type,
    p_entity_id,
    p_to_state,
    p_from_state,
    p_metadata
  )
  ON CONFLICT (entity_type, entity_id)
  DO UPDATE SET
    current_state = EXCLUDED.current_state,
    previous_state = EXCLUDED.previous_state,
    updated_at = NOW();

  INSERT INTO fsm_events (
    id,
    institution_id,
    entity_type,
    entity_id,
    event_type,
    from_state,
    to_state,
    metadata,
    created_at
  )
  VALUES (
    gen_random_uuid(),
    p_institution_id,
    p_entity_type,
    p_entity_id,
    'STATE_CHANGE',
    p_from_state,
    p_to_state,
    p_metadata,
    NOW()
  );

END;
$function$
functions.identity_arguments: p_entity_type text, p_entity_id uuid, p_from_state text, p_to_state text, p_institution_id uuid, p_metadata jsonb

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_cbt_active_attempt(p_exam_id uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public', 'auth'
AS $function$
declare
  v_student_id uuid;
  v_result jsonb;
begin
  if auth.uid() is null then raise exception 'Authentication required'; end if;

  select id into v_student_id
  from public.students
  where user_id=auth.uid()
  order by created_at nulls last,id
  limit 1;

  if v_student_id is null then
    return jsonb_build_object('active',false);
  end if;

  select jsonb_build_object(
    'active',true,
    'attempt_id',a.id,
    'attempt_number',a.attempt_number,
    'session_id',s.id,
    'start_time',a.start_time,
    'deadline_at',a.deadline_at,
    'status',a.status,
    'session_state',s.state,
    'current_question',s.current_question
  ) into v_result
  from public.cbt_attempts a
  join public.cbt_sessions s on s.attempt_id=a.id
  where a.exam_id=p_exam_id
    and a.student_id=v_student_id
    and a.status='in_progress'
  order by a.attempt_number desc,a.created_at desc
  limit 1;

  return coalesce(v_result,jsonb_build_object('active',false));
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_cbt_attempt_state(p_attempt_id uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public', 'auth'
AS $function$
declare
  v_state jsonb;
begin
  if auth.uid() is null then raise exception 'Authentication required'; end if;

  select jsonb_build_object(
    'success',true,
    'attempt_id',a.id,
    'exam_id',a.exam_id,
    'deadline_at',a.deadline_at,
    'status',a.status,
    'session_id',s.id,
    'session_state',s.state,
    'current_question',coalesce(
      (select snap.current_question
       from public.cbt_session_snapshots snap
       where snap.session_id=s.id
       order by snap.created_at desc,snap.id desc
       limit 1),
      s.current_question
    ),
    'remaining_time',coalesce(
      (select snap.remaining_time
       from public.cbt_session_snapshots snap
       where snap.session_id=s.id
       order by snap.created_at desc,snap.id desc
       limit 1),
      s.remaining_time
    ),
    'answers',coalesce((
      select jsonb_object_agg(ans.question_id::text,ans.selected_option_id::text)
      from public.cbt_answers ans
      where ans.attempt_id=a.id and ans.selected_option_id is not null
    ),'{}'::jsonb)
  ) into v_state
  from public.cbt_attempts a
  join public.students st on st.id=a.student_id
  join public.cbt_sessions s on s.attempt_id=a.id
  where a.id=p_attempt_id and st.user_id=auth.uid();

  if v_state is null then
    raise exception 'CBT_ATTEMPT_NOT_FOUND_OR_NOT_OWNED';
  end if;
  return v_state;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_class_performance(p_class_id uuid, p_term_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
AS $function$
DECLARE
    v_performance JSONB;
    v_class_name TEXT;
    v_total_students INT;
BEGIN
    -- Get class name
    SELECT name INTO v_class_name
    FROM classes
    WHERE id = p_class_id;
    
    -- Get total students in class
    SELECT COUNT(*) INTO v_total_students
    FROM students
    WHERE class_id = p_class_id;
    
    -- Get subject-wise performance
    SELECT jsonb_agg(
        jsonb_build_object(
            'subject_id', sc.id,
            'subject_name', sc.name,
            'exams_taken', COUNT(DISTINCT e.id),
            'average_score', ROUND(AVG(cr.percentage)::NUMERIC, 1),
            'highest_score', MAX(cr.percentage),
            'lowest_score', MIN(cr.percentage),
            'total_participants', COUNT(DISTINCT cr.student_id)
        ) ORDER BY sc.name
    ) INTO v_performance
    FROM subject_catalog sc
    JOIN cbt_exams e ON e.subject_id = sc.id AND e.class_id = p_class_id
    JOIN cbt_results_summary cr ON cr.exam_id = e.id
    WHERE (p_term_id IS NULL OR e.term_id = p_term_id)
    GROUP BY sc.id, sc.name;
    
    RETURN jsonb_build_object(
        'success', true,
        'class_id', p_class_id,
        'class_name', v_class_name,
        'total_students', v_total_students,
        'subjects', COALESCE(v_performance, '[]'::JSONB)
    );
END;
$function$

functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_exam_status(p_attempt_id uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public', 'auth'
AS $function$
declare
  v_attempt record;
  v_answers_count integer;
begin
  /*
   * Candidate data is visible only to the owning authenticated user.
   * Trusted server-side service_role access is retained for existing
   * server integrations. An unauthorized caller receives the same
   * response as a nonexistent attempt.
   */
  select
    a.id,
    a.status,
    a.score,
    a.total_marks,
    a.end_time,
    (
      select count(*)
      from public.cbt_questions q
      where q.exam_id = a.exam_id
    ) as total_questions
  into v_attempt
  from public.cbt_attempts a
  join public.students s on s.id = a.student_id
  where a.id = p_attempt_id
    and (
      s.user_id = auth.uid()
      or auth.role() = 'service_role'
    );

  if not found then
    return jsonb_build_object(
      'success', false,
      'error', 'Attempt not found'
    );
  end if;

  select count(*)
  into v_answers_count
  from public.cbt_answers a
  where a.attempt_id = p_attempt_id;

  return jsonb_build_object(
    'success', true,
    'attempt_id', p_attempt_id,
    'status', v_attempt.status,
    'score', v_attempt.score,
    'total_marks', v_attempt.total_marks,
    'questions_answered', v_answers_count,
    'total_questions', v_attempt.total_questions,
    'progress',
      case
        when v_attempt.total_questions > 0
          then round((v_answers_count::numeric / v_attempt.total_questions::numeric) * 100)
        else 0
      end,
    'time_remaining',
      greatest(0, extract(epoch from (v_attempt.end_time - now()))::integer),
    'time_expired', now() > v_attempt.end_time
  );
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_printable_results(p_exam_id uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public', 'auth'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_exam_info jsonb;
  v_students jsonb;
BEGIN
  PERFORM public.assert_exam_access(p_exam_id);

  SELECT jsonb_build_object(
    'exam_title',e.title,'exam_date',e.exam_date,'total_marks',e.total_marks,
    'pass_mark',e.pass_mark,'class_name',c.name,'subject_name',sc.name,
    'school_name',s.school_name,'principal_name',s.principal_name
  ) INTO v_exam_info
  FROM public.cbt_exams e
  JOIN public.classes c ON c.id=e.class_id
  JOIN public.schools s ON s.id=e.school_id
  JOIN public.subject_catalog sc ON sc.id=e.subject_id
  WHERE e.id=p_exam_id;
  IF v_exam_info IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'EXAM_NOT_FOUND'; END IF;

  SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
    'student_name',s.first_name||' '||s.last_name,
    'student_number',s.student_number,'score',cr.score,
    'percentage',round(cr.percentage,1),'grade',cr.grade,'position',cr.position,
    'remarks',CASE WHEN cr.percentage>=75 THEN 'EXCELLENT'
      WHEN cr.percentage>=65 THEN 'VERY GOOD'
      WHEN cr.percentage>=50 THEN 'GOOD'
      WHEN cr.percentage>=40 THEN 'FAIR' ELSE 'NEEDS IMPROVEMENT' END
  ) ORDER BY cr.position)
  INTO v_students
  FROM public.cbt_results_summary cr
  JOIN public.students s ON s.id=cr.student_id
  WHERE cr.exam_id=p_exam_id;

  RETURN v_exam_info||jsonb_build_object('success',true,
    'students',coalesce(v_students,'[]'::jsonb),'generated_at',now());
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_school_students(p_school_id uuid, p_search text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_limit integer DEFAULT 100, p_offset integer DEFAULT 0)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
declare
  v_result jsonb;
begin
  if auth.uid() is null or not exists (
    select 1
    from public.profiles p
    join public.schools s on s.id = p_school_id
    where p.user_id = auth.uid()
      and (
        (p.role = 'principal_admin' and p.school_id = p_school_id)
        or (p.role = 'dean' and p.institution_id = s.institution_id)
      )
  ) then raise exception 'SCHOOL_SCOPE_DENIED'; end if;

  with filtered as (
    select s.id, s.first_name, s.last_name, s.student_number, s.class_id,
           s.gender, s.email, s.phone, s.cgpa, s.enrollment_status, c.name as class_name
    from public.students s
    left join public.classes c on c.id = s.class_id
    where s.school_id = p_school_id
      and (
        p_search is null
        or s.first_name ilike '%' || p_search || '%'
        or s.last_name ilike '%' || p_search || '%'
        or s.student_number ilike '%' || p_search || '%'
      )
  ),
  paged as (
    select * from filtered
    order by last_name, first_name, id
    limit greatest(coalesce(p_limit, 100), 0)
    offset greatest(coalesce(p_offset, 0), 0)
  )
  select jsonb_build_object(
    'total', (select count(*) from filtered),
    'students', coalesce((
      select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
        'id', id,
        'first_name', first_name,
        'last_name', last_name,
        'student_number', student_number,
        'class_name', class_name,
        'class_id', class_id,
        'gender', gender,
        'email', email,
        'phone', phone,
        'cgpa', cgpa,
        'enrollment_status', enrollment_status
      ) order by last_name, first_name, id)
      from paged
    ), '[]'::jsonb)
  ) into v_result;

  return v_result;
end;
$function$

  with filtered as (

    from public.teachers t
    where t.school_id = p_school_id
      and (
        p_search is null
        or t.name ilike '%' || p_search || '%'
        or t.email ilike '%' || p_search || '%'
      )
  ),
  paged as (
    select * from filtered
    order by name, id
    limit greatest(coalesce(p_limit, 100), 0)
    offset greatest(coalesce(p_offset, 0), 0)
  )
  select jsonb_build_object(
    'total', (select count(*) from filtered),
    'teachers', coalesce((
      select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
        'id', t.id,
        'name', t.name,
        'email', t.email,
        'phone', t.phone,
        'class_count', (select count(*) from public.teacher_classes tc where tc.teacher_id = t.id),
        'student_count', (
          select count(distinct s.id)
          from public.students s
          join public.teacher_classes tc on tc.class_id = s.class_id
          where tc.teacher_id = t.id
        )
      ) order by t.name, t.id)
      from paged t
    ), '[]'::jsonb)
  ) into v_result;

  return v_result;
end;
$function$

  FROM public.students WHERE id=p_student_id;
  IF NOT FOUND OR v_student_user_id IS NULL OR v_student_user_id<>auth.uid() THEN

  JOIN public.classes c ON c.id=e.class_id

    'results',coalesce(v_results,'[]'::jsonb),

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_teacher_details(p_teacher_id uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
AS $function$
DECLARE
    v_result JSONB;
    v_teacher RECORD;
    v_classes JSONB;
    v_subjects JSONB;
    v_cbt_exams JSONB;
    v_ai_grading JSONB;
    v_activity JSONB;
BEGIN
    -- Get teacher profile
    SELECT 
        t.id, t.name, t.email, t.phone, t.institution_id, t.school_id, t.created_at
    INTO v_teacher
    FROM public.teachers t
    WHERE t.id = p_teacher_id;
    
    IF v_teacher.id IS NULL THEN
        RETURN jsonb_build_object('error', 'Teacher not found');
    END IF;
    
    -- ============================================
    -- 1. ASSIGNED CLASSES
    -- ============================================
    SELECT COALESCE(
        jsonb_agg(
            jsonb_build_object(
                'class_id', c.id,
                'class_name', c.name,
                'student_count', (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM students WHERE class_id = c.id)
            ) ORDER BY c.name
        ),
        '[]'::jsonb
    ) INTO v_classes
    FROM teacher_classes tc
    JOIN classes c ON c.id = tc.class_id
    WHERE tc.teacher_id = p_teacher_id;
    
    -- ============================================
    -- 2. SUBJECTS TAUGHT
    -- ============================================
    SELECT COALESCE(
        jsonb_agg(
            jsonb_build_object(
                'subject_id', cs.subject_id,
                'subject_name', s.name,
                'class_id', cs.class_id,
                'class_name', c.name
            ) ORDER BY s.name
        ),
        '[]'::jsonb
    ) INTO v_subjects
    FROM teacher_subject_assignments tsa
    JOIN class_subjects cs ON cs.id = tsa.class_subject_id
    JOIN subjects s ON s.id = cs.subject_id
    LEFT JOIN classes c ON c.id = cs.class_id
    WHERE tsa.teacher_id = p_teacher_id;
    
    -- ============================================
    -- 3. CBT EXAMS CREATED
    -- ============================================
    SELECT COALESCE(
        jsonb_agg(
            jsonb_build_object(
                'exam_id', ce.id,
                'title', ce.title,
                'subject_id', ce.subject_id,
                'subject_name', sc.name,
                'class_id', ce.class_id,
                'class_name', c.name,
                'duration_minutes', ce.duration_minutes,
                'total_marks', ce.total_marks,
                'pass_mark', ce.pass_mark,
                'exam_date', ce.exam_date,
                'status', ce.status,
                'created_at', ce.created_at,
                'student_count', (
                    SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT student_id) 
                    FROM cbt_attempts 
                    WHERE exam_id = ce.id
                ),
                'average_score', (
                    SELECT ROUND(AVG(percentage)::NUMERIC, 1)
                    FROM cbt_results_summary 
                    WHERE exam_id = ce.id
                ),
                'pass_rate', (
                    SELECT ROUND(
                        (COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE percentage >= ce.pass_mark)::NUMERIC / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0)::NUMERIC) * 100, 1
                    )
                    FROM cbt_results_summary 
                    WHERE exam_id = ce.id
                )
            ) ORDER BY ce.created_at DESC
        ),
        '[]'::jsonb
    ) INTO v_cbt_exams
    FROM cbt_exams ce
    LEFT JOIN subject_catalog sc ON sc.id = ce.subject_id
    LEFT JOIN classes c ON c.id = ce.class_id
    WHERE ce.created_by = p_teacher_id;
    
    -- ============================================
    -- 4. AI GRADING RESULTS (Using actual columns)
    -- ============================================
    SELECT COALESCE(
        jsonb_agg(
            jsonb_build_object(
                'script_id', as1.id,
                'student_id', as1.student_id,
                'student_name', s.first_name || ' ' || s.last_name,
                'student_number', s.student_number,
                'assignment_title', as1.assignment_title,
                'subject_id', as1.subject_id,
                'subject_name', sc.name,
                'class_id', s.class_id,
                'class_name', c.name,
                'ai_score', as1.ai_score,
                'confidence', as1.confidence,
                'ai_feedback', as1.ai_feedback,
                'final_score', as1.final_score,
                'status', as1.status,
                'teacher_feedback', as1.teacher_feedback,
                'grading_status', as1.grading_status,
                'reviewed_by', as1.reviewed_by,
                'reviewed_at', as1.reviewed_at,
                'released_at', as1.released_at,
                'created_at', as1.created_at
            ) ORDER BY as1.created_at DESC
        ),
        '[]'::jsonb
    ) INTO v_ai_grading
    FROM (
        SELECT * FROM answer_scripts 
        WHERE teacher_id = p_teacher_id 
        ORDER BY created_at DESC 
        LIMIT 50
    ) as1
    LEFT JOIN students s ON s.id = as1.student_id
    LEFT JOIN classes c ON c.id = s.class_id
    LEFT JOIN subject_catalog sc ON sc.id = as1.subject_id;
    
    -- ============================================
    -- 5. ACTIVITY LOG (Limited to 50)
    -- ============================================
    SELECT COALESCE(
        jsonb_agg(
            jsonb_build_object(
                'id', al.id,
                'date', al.created_at,
                'action', al.action,
                'resource_type', al.resource_type,
                'resource_id', al.resource_id,
                'description', al.metadata->>'description',
                'details', al.metadata
            ) ORDER BY al.created_at DESC
        ),
        '[]'::jsonb
    ) INTO v_activity
    FROM (
        SELECT * FROM activity_logs 
        WHERE actor_user_id = p_teacher_id
        OR resource_id = p_teacher_id
        ORDER BY created_at DESC 
        LIMIT 50
    ) al;
    
    -- ============================================
    -- 6. BUILD FINAL RESULT
    -- ============================================
    SELECT jsonb_build_object(
        'teacher', jsonb_build_object(
            'id', v_teacher.id,
            'name', v_teacher.name,
            'email', v_teacher.email,
            'phone', v_teacher.phone,
            'institution_id', v_teacher.institution_id,
            'school_id', v_teacher.school_id,
            'created_at', v_teacher.created_at
        ),
        'classes', v_classes,
        'subjects', v_subjects,
        'cbt_exams', v_cbt_exams,
        'ai_grading', v_ai_grading,
        'pending_reviews', (
            SELECT COUNT(*)
            FROM grading_jobs gj
            JOIN answer_scripts as1 ON as1.id = gj.script_id
            WHERE as1.teacher_id = p_teacher_id
            AND gj.status = 'pending'
        ),
        'grading_stats', jsonb_build_object(
            'total_submissions', (
                SELECT COUNT(*) FROM answer_scripts WHERE teacher_id = p_teacher_id
            ),
            'approved', (
                SELECT COUNT(*) FROM answer_scripts WHERE teacher_id = p_teacher_id AND status = 'approved'
            ),
            'overridden', (
                SELECT COUNT(*) FROM answer_scripts WHERE teacher_id = p_teacher_id AND status = 'overridden'
            ),
            'pending', (
                SELECT COUNT(*) FROM answer_scripts WHERE teacher_id = p_teacher_id AND status IN ('pending_supervisor', 'pending_review')
            ),
            'released', (
                SELECT COUNT(*) FROM answer_scripts WHERE teacher_id = p_teacher_id AND status = 'released'
            ),
            'average_ai_score', (
                SELECT ROUND(AVG(ai_score)::NUMERIC, 1) FROM answer_scripts WHERE teacher_id = p_teacher_id AND ai_score IS NOT NULL
            ),
            'average_final_score', (
                SELECT ROUND(AVG(final_score)::NUMERIC, 1) FROM answer_scripts WHERE teacher_id = p_teacher_id AND final_score IS NOT NULL
            )
        ),
        'activity', v_activity,
        'recent_activity_summary', jsonb_build_object(
            'last_7_days', (
                SELECT COUNT(*) FROM activity_logs 
                WHERE actor_user_id = p_teacher_id
                AND created_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days'
            ),
            'last_30_days', (
                SELECT COUNT(*) FROM activity_logs 
                WHERE actor_user_id = p_teacher_id
                AND created_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days'
            ),
            'last_login', (
                SELECT last_login_at FROM profiles
                WHERE user_id = (SELECT user_id FROM teachers WHERE id = p_teacher_id)
            )
        )
    ) INTO v_result;
    
    RETURN v_result;
EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN
    RETURN jsonb_build_object('error', SQLERRM);
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_teacher_exam_results(p_exam_id uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public', 'auth'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_results jsonb;
  v_stats jsonb;
  v_grade_distribution jsonb;
  v_exam_details record;
BEGIN
  PERFORM public.assert_exam_access(p_exam_id);

  SELECT e.*,sc.name AS subject_name,c.name AS class_name
  INTO v_exam_details
  FROM public.cbt_exams e
  JOIN public.subject_catalog sc ON sc.id=e.subject_id
  JOIN public.classes c ON c.id=e.class_id
  WHERE e.id=p_exam_id;
  IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'EXAM_NOT_FOUND'; END IF;

  SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
      'student_id',s.id,'student_name',s.first_name||' '||s.last_name,
      'student_number',s.student_number,'score',cr.score,
      'total_marks',cr.total_marks,'percentage',round(cr.percentage,1),
      'grade',cr.grade,'position',cr.position,'submitted_at',a.submitted_at,
      'time_taken',extract(epoch from (a.submitted_at-a.start_time))::integer/60
    ) ORDER BY cr.position)
  INTO v_results
  FROM public.cbt_results_summary cr
  JOIN public.students s ON s.id=cr.student_id
  JOIN public.cbt_attempts a ON a.id=cr.attempt_id
  WHERE cr.exam_id=p_exam_id;

  SELECT jsonb_build_object(
    'total_students',count(*),'average_score',round(avg(percentage)::numeric,1),
    'highest_score',max(percentage),'lowest_score',min(percentage),
    'total_passed',count(*) FILTER(WHERE percentage>=v_exam_details.pass_mark),
    'total_failed',count(*) FILTER(WHERE percentage<v_exam_details.pass_mark),
    'pass_percentage',coalesce(round((count(*) FILTER(WHERE percentage>=v_exam_details.pass_mark)::numeric/
      nullif(count(*),0)::numeric)*100,1),0)
  ) INTO v_stats
  FROM public.cbt_results_summary WHERE exam_id=p_exam_id;

  SELECT jsonb_build_object(
    'A',count(*) FILTER(WHERE grade='A'),'B',count(*) FILTER(WHERE grade='B'),
    'C',count(*) FILTER(WHERE grade='C'),'D',count(*) FILTER(WHERE grade='D'),
    'F',count(*) FILTER(WHERE grade='F')
  ) INTO v_grade_distribution
  FROM public.cbt_results_summary WHERE exam_id=p_exam_id;

  RETURN jsonb_build_object('success',true,'exam_id',p_exam_id,
    'exam_title',v_exam_details.title,'subject',v_exam_details.subject_name,
    'class',v_exam_details.class_name,'date',v_exam_details.exam_date,
    'total_marks',v_exam_details.total_marks,'pass_mark',v_exam_details.pass_mark,
    'statistics',v_stats,'grade_distribution',v_grade_distribution,
    'results',coalesce(v_results,'[]'::jsonb));
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_top_performers(p_school_id uuid, p_class_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid, p_limit integer DEFAULT 10)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
AS $function$
DECLARE
    v_leaderboard JSONB;
BEGIN
    SELECT jsonb_agg(
        jsonb_build_object(
            'student_id', s.id,
            'student_name', s.first_name || ' ' || s.last_name,
            'student_number', s.student_number,
            'class', s.class_name,
            'average_score', ROUND(s.avg_percentage, 1),
            'exams_taken', s.exam_count,
            'total_score', s.total_score
        ) 
    ) INTO v_leaderboard
    FROM (
        SELECT 
            s.id,
            s.first_name,
            s.last_name,
            s.student_number,
            c.name as class_name,
            AVG(cr.percentage) as avg_percentage,
            COUNT(DISTINCT cr.exam_id) as exam_count,
            SUM(cr.score) as total_score
        FROM students s
        JOIN classes c ON c.id = s.class_id
        JOIN cbt_results_summary cr ON cr.student_id = s.id
        WHERE c.school_id = p_school_id
        AND (p_class_id IS NULL OR s.class_id = p_class_id)
        GROUP BY s.id, s.first_name, s.last_name, s.student_number, c.name
        HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT cr.exam_id) >= 1
        ORDER BY avg_percentage DESC
        LIMIT p_limit
    ) s;
    
    RETURN jsonb_build_object(
        'success', true,
        'school_id', p_school_id,
        'class_id', p_class_id,
        'top_performers', COALESCE(v_leaderboard, '[]'::JSONB)
    );
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.initialize_class_subjects(p_school_id uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
AS $function$
DECLARE
    v_classes_count INT;
    v_subjects_count INT;
    v_inserted_count INT;
BEGIN
    -- Get counts
    SELECT COUNT(*) INTO v_classes_count
    FROM classes 
    WHERE school_id = p_school_id;

    SELECT COUNT(*) INTO v_subjects_count
    FROM subject_catalog;

    -- Insert missing combinations
    WITH combinations AS (
        SELECT 
            p_school_id as school_id,
            c.id as class_id,
            sc.id as subject_id
        FROM classes c
        CROSS JOIN subject_catalog sc
        WHERE c.school_id = p_school_id
    ),
    inserted AS (
        INSERT INTO class_subjects (school_id, class_id, subject_id, created_at, updated_at)
        SELECT 
            school_id,
            class_id,
            subject_id,
            NOW(),
            NOW()
        FROM combinations
        ON CONFLICT (school_id, class_id, subject_id) DO NOTHING
        RETURNING 1
    )
    SELECT COUNT(*) INTO v_inserted_count FROM inserted;

    RETURN jsonb_build_object(
        'success', true,
        'school_id', p_school_id,
        'classes', v_classes_count,
        'catalog_subjects', v_subjects_count,
        'combinations_created', v_inserted_count,
        'total_possible', v_classes_count * v_subjects_count
    );
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.initialize_secondary_classes(p_school_id uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
AS $function$
DECLARE
    inserted_count INT;
BEGIN
    WITH new_classes AS (
        INSERT INTO classes (school_id, name)
        SELECT p_school_id, v.name
        FROM (
            VALUES
            ('JSS 1'),
            ('JSS 2'),
            ('JSS 3'),
            ('SS 1'),
            ('SS 2'),
            ('SS 3')
        ) AS v(name)
        WHERE NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM classes c
            WHERE c.school_id = p_school_id
            AND c.name = v.name
        )
        RETURNING id
    )
    SELECT COUNT(*) INTO inserted_count FROM new_classes;
    
    RETURN jsonb_build_object(
        'success', true,
        'classes_created', inserted_count,
        'message', format('Created %s new classes', inserted_count)
    );
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.mark_students_created()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
BEGIN
  UPDATE institution_onboarding
  SET students_created = true,
      updated_at = now()

      SELECT institution_id

      WHERE id = (
          SELECT school_id

      )
  );

END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.override_grading(p_script_id uuid, p_reviewer_id uuid, p_final_score numeric, p_override_justification text, p_teacher_feedback text DEFAULT NULL::text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
AS $function$
DECLARE
    v_script_id UUID;
BEGIN
    -- Require justification for override
    IF p_override_justification IS NULL OR p_override_justification = '' THEN
        RETURN jsonb_build_object('success', false, 'error', 'Override justification is required');
    END IF;

    -- Validate justification length
    IF LENGTH(p_override_justification) < 10 THEN
        RETURN jsonb_build_object('success', false, 'error', 'Override justification must be at least 10 characters');
    END IF;

    UPDATE public.answer_scripts
    SET 
        final_score = p_final_score,
        reviewed_by = p_reviewer_id,
        reviewed_at = NOW(),
        status = 'overridden',
        override_justification = p_override_justification,
        teacher_feedback = p_teacher_feedback,
        updated_at = NOW()
    WHERE id = p_script_id
    AND status IN ('pending_review', 'processing')
    RETURNING id INTO v_script_id;

    IF v_script_id IS NULL THEN
        RETURN jsonb_build_object('success', false, 'error', 'Script not found or not in review state');
    END IF;

    RETURN jsonb_build_object(
        'success', true,
        'script_id', v_script_id,
        'status', 'overridden',
        'final_score', p_final_score,
        'override_justification', p_override_justification
    );
END;
$function$
functions.identity_arguments: p_script_id uuid, p_reviewer_id uuid, p_final_score numeric, p_override_justification text, p_teacher_feedback text

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.reset_stuck_grading_jobs()
 RETURNS integer
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
DECLARE
    reset_count INT;
BEGIN
    UPDATE grading_jobs
    SET status = 'pending',
        worker_id = NULL,
        processed_at = NULL,
        attempts = attempts + 1
    WHERE status = 'processing'
    AND processed_at < now() - interval '1 hour';
    
    GET DIAGNOSTICS reset_count = ROW_COUNT;
    RETURN reset_count;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.resolve_context(p_user_id uuid, p_context_type text)
 RETURNS uuid
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
DECLARE
    resolved uuid;
BEGIN
    SELECT resolved_entity_id
    INTO resolved
    FROM context_resolver_state
    WHERE user_id = p_user_id
      AND context_type = p_context_type
      AND is_active = true
    LIMIT 1;

    IF resolved IS NULL THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Context not resolved for user % and type %',
        p_user_id, p_context_type;
    END IF;

    RETURN resolved;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.resolve_principal_identity()
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
AS $function$
DECLARE
    principal_record RECORD;
BEGIN
    SELECT
        p.id AS principal_id,
        p.school_id,
        p.name AS principal_name,
        p.email AS principal_email
    INTO principal_record
    FROM principals p
    WHERE p.user_id = auth.uid();

    IF NOT FOUND THEN
        RETURN NULL;
    END IF;

    RETURN row_to_json(principal_record)::jsonb;
END;
$function$

DECLARE
    student_record RECORD;
BEGIN

    SELECT
        s.id               AS student_id,
        s.user_id,
        s.school_id,
        s.institution_id,
        s.class_id,
        s.student_number,
        s.first_name,
        s.last_name
    INTO student_record
    FROM students s
    WHERE s.user_id = auth.uid();

    IF NOT FOUND THEN
        RETURN NULL;
    END IF;

    RETURN row_to_json(student_record)::jsonb;

END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.use_public_trial(p_fingerprint text)
 RETURNS integer
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
AS $function$
DECLARE
  remaining INTEGER;
BEGIN
  UPDATE public.public_user_trials
  SET 
    checks_remaining = checks_remaining - 1,
    used_checks = used_checks + 1,
    last_used_at = NOW()
  WHERE device_fingerprint = p_fingerprint
    AND checks_remaining > 0
  RETURNING checks_remaining INTO remaining;
  
  RETURN COALESCE(remaining, 0);
END;
$function$
